executive_summary.headline: Multiple high-exposure suppliers posted unexplained stock moves over seven days; ITC and Smoore showed extreme volatility with no confirmed cause, now stabilized to GREEN but warrant monitoring.
executive_summary.next_step: Pull a 30-minute call with operations and finance to map ITC and Smoore exposure by SKU and customer, and establish a trigger for escalation if either stock moves >3% again without news within the next two weeks.
executive_summary.context: ITC (high BAT exposure) swung -4.0%, +4.3%, and -4.0% intra-week—each move 3.7× normal daily range—while Smoore (critical BAT exposure) crashed -5.5%, all without corroborating signals or confirmed drivers. Texas Instruments and Jabil also drifted down ~3% unconfirmed. The cycle has now settled to GREEN across all pillars, but the pattern of large, unexplained moves in key suppliers over seven days suggests either coordinated sector stress worth investigating or isolated margin/liquidity pressure not yet visible in macro data.
